RATIONALE: Retain the previously proposed 5% engineering corroboration band without fitting source outcomes. A 2% band would assert tighter precision than has been justified; a 10% band would weaken corroboration without a documented need. The 5% choice is a declared design convention, not a calibrated instrument-accuracy bound. It is necessary within Route B and never sufficient by itself to classify a capacity check. The later reviewer-reported 1.81% example did not select this value and is not treated here as independent validation.
change_policy: No in-version change; feasibility counts are not a reason to widen the band. Any change requires a new reviewed contract version and preservation/reporting of prior results.
